recentItems.title: Protesters gather outside Ed Sheeran's 1st show since Macklemore dropped from tour
recentItems.description:

CBC News spoke outside the venue with both fans attending the show and pro-Palestinian activists who had gathered in support of the Palestinian people and free speech.

recentItems.description:
